standing_instructions: Every eval prompt ends with the same block, headed 'Run conditions'. It tells the agent that nobody answers during the run, gives the answers the eval assumes, and replaces ExitPlanMode with printing the plan. An eval added later carries the block too.

evals.prompt:
the csv export in this repo writes due dates in local time, so the same invoice shows a different date depending on which office ran the export. it's one function in one file. plan the fix

Run conditions
- Nobody answers during this run. Ask nothing: no AskUserQuestion call, no question left waiting, no mark that awaits an answer.
- Assumed facts, to use as known lines marked "given by the eval": the repository root is /work/ledger; the function is formatDueDate(due: Date): string in src/export/dates.ts, called by src/export/csv.ts and src/export/pdf.ts; the fix writes dates in UTC; `just test` passes on main; the machine has git, a justfile, and a lefthook pre-commit hook, and no worktree tool; plan mode is off; the agent list holds no coordinator agent.
- Every other question the skill would put to a person: settle it yourself, and record it in the plan under a heading "Questions settled", one line each, as the question, the answer you chose, and why.
- No repository is at hand. Where the skill has you read code or run a check or a script, use the assumed facts, and add under "Questions settled" each further fact you had to assume.
- Do not call ExitPlanMode. Treat the plan as approved once it is written, print the plan file in full as your final output, and stop before any implementation.
evals.expected_output: A lean plan: a Run line saying the reader runs the plan, one user story whose subject is a person, a Boundaries part stating the function's signature as it stays, one unit with the behavior its first failing test pins and the remaining cases left to the agent, the state of the checks before work, and no contracts section, module map, coordination section, lane entry, or run book.
assertions: The output holds no AskUserQuestion call, no ExitPlanMode call, and no question addressed to a person.
The plan has a Run line stating that the reader runs the plan itself.
The plan has exactly one user story, and its subject is a person, not a system, module, or agent.
The plan has a Boundaries part that states the signature formatDueDate(due: Date): string and says it stays as it is.
The plan's Work part names one behavior its first failing test pins, and leaves the remaining test cases to the agent in words.
The plan has no Contracts section, no Module map, no Coordination section, no lane entry, and names no run book.
The plan has a "Questions settled" heading, and each line under it gives a question, a chosen answer, and a reason.
